judgments.reason: The model_articulation does not describe the proposed mechanism (commission being included before payment enabling over-bids). No quoted text explains that commissions are applied prior to charging the winner or that this allows bids above available coins.

The model_articulation shows the focal player requesting bid info but does not articulate the specific mechanism that waiting exposes already-committed rival bid VALUES while the focal player remains uncommitted. The transcript evidence does not show the model explaining that timing/information advantage, so this is not a demonstrated discovery.

The model_articulation never claims or explains that 'close' can settle before all lots are sold. The transcript contains no example of an early settlement; the model did not articulate this discrepancy.

Although the play trace shows anomalous score/owned changes suggesting commission-like effects on catalog purchases, the model_articulation does not state the mechanism (that the three-coin commission is paid on catalog buys). Because the model did not articulate that mechanism or connect it to an observed outcome, this is not a validated discovery.
